column1: # p388 — 2026-10-22 — first-hand reads. Channels used, and their state this pass:
#   LIVE   git ls-remote --symref https://github.com/<slug> HEAD        -> address + REAL default ref + HEAD sha  (OPEN)
#   LIC    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<slug>/<ref>/<path>        -> licence read from the raw payload      (OPEN)
#   NPM    https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>                             -> declared licence + full publish history (OPEN)
#   NEW    https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=<q>&size=25      -> DISCOVERY of new addresses             (OPEN — new this pass)
#   'AUTH-REQUIRED(private-or-absent)' = ls-remote prompted for credentials: the repository is NOT publicly readable,
#   even though the package is published on npm. licence_read '-' on such a row means no payload could be read at all.
